_comment: Task log for the 17 Aug 2026 QA remediation register. The qa-register gate in scripts/verify.py FAILS while any finding is open OR any closed finding lacks evidence, so verify.py cannot go green - and nothing can deploy - until the register is genuinely finished. A finding is 'closed' only when its fix is committed AND it carries evidence. Evidence kinds: test:<path> (automated, strongest), gate:<name> (mechanically prevents recurrence), manual:<what> (human/browser only - counted and reported separately because it does not survive a refactor). 'reviewed' means a separate adversarial reviewer examined the diff. 'deployed' is set only once the fix is live in production. Partially fixed findings stay OPEN with a note - 'mostly done' is open.

findings.title: The element-generation prompt has no repository context and no duplicate-avoidance instruction
Platform suffers complete outages under trivial load
findings.note: root-caused as memcg OOM (9ead4e9). REPRODUCED LIVE 18 Aug 08:31 by a single `docker compose exec server flask` diagnostic, which boots a second full app inside the 2600m cgroup and killed gunicorn/PID 1. Headroom is one Python process. Needs a RAM decision from the owner; operational rule adopted: never run flask CLI in the prod container.

These are the modules carrying contract value, ARC, savings and budget — a GBP/USD confusion is ~27% error on any number a user acts on, and there is no currency setting or on-screen currency code.

findings.title: CSRF is not enforced on the write surface — supersedes A-04's scoping
findings.note: NINE of nine testable write endpoints reached business logic with NO token, including /applications/bulk-delete which EXECUTED (200), /arb/reviews/create, /solutions/<id>/delete-json and — most seriously — /ai-chat/approvals/<id>/approve, the gate through which agent writes execute and the same gate V-01 shows has no authorization either. A-04 said CSRF was implemented and inconsistently applied; the accurate position is a token exists on server-rendered admin FORMS and is enforced on NONE of the JSON write endpoints. Fix as default-deny middleware with an explicit opt-out list; enumerate the full route table.

_register_discrepancy: The 18 Aug register header claims '115 raised, 4 withdrawn, 3 revised, 1 verified fixed -> 107 active'. Two things in that do not reconcile and are recorded rather than smoothed over. (1) The '1 verified fixed' finding is never NAMED anywhere: no correction-ledger row, no status change in the Section 5 index, and no finding described as fixed in either document. Nothing has been marked closed on that basis. (2) 104 -> 115 raised is +11, but only 7 findings (I-01, M-01..M-06) are actually merged into the register's clusters and index; M-07 and M-08 appear in the Update-4 source document but in neither, and are carried here anyway because a finding dropped by an untriaged summary is still a finding. That leaves 2 raised findings unaccounted for. If they surface in a later document they get added here.
